title: Bump the opum-lore and opum-quest pins to 0.15.0 as ONE paired window (Article 3.4), with re-resolved baselines, CLAUDE.md managed block and schema export
description: Part of the 2026-10-31 approved plan item 8 (Ship lore and quest 0.15.0, lore-cli LCLI-775). lore-cli tag v0.15.0: annotated tag object e9a27a6c09faf8326e6c8f94fd259d4216285908 peels to commit 7b6176842e18c929039b155706b6a537130993eb; skills/ tree a64e795ea6d2b18ba1351b6e6b080d0a245d738b (moved since v0.14.1, whose skills/ tree was 060393c9); root tree 156a3fae68d7eedb8d6169343511c511b20a0e7b. All four re-read by ref from opum-ai/lore-cli. HELD: do not start until the leader has run the DEC-226 floor on this id (paths scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json) and sent a brief, AND lore 0.15.0 is published on npm (a schema export or lore check before then runs 0.14.x and proves nothing). Floor-class work: pins and baselines.

acceptanceCriteria.text: marketplace.json opum-lore AND opum-quest entries pin ref v0.15.0, and each plugin.json at its tag declares 0.15.0

scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json opum-lore and opum-quest skills/ subtree SHAs are each re-resolved independently by ref at v0.15.0 (lore not carried forward from a64e795e) and equal the tag skills/ tree
CLAUDE.md Quest block reads 0.15.0 via quest agents --update-instructions --target claude and no hand-written line changed
the lore schema export is produced under the published lore 0.15.0 binary, with the installed lore and quest versions printed
check manifests, Tracker integrity and lore check are green on the PR head, with both lore and quest installed by exact version 0.15.0

implementationNotes: 2026-11-02, widened to the PAIR on the leader's instruction (opum-doc ruling). Opum constitution Article 3.4 makes the lore and quest release a pair, so this one record names ONE window for both: marketplace.json opum-lore AND opum-quest refs, both scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json entries, and the CLAUDE.md:48 Quest block all move in the same PR, so a half-move cannot happen. Rulings: (1) lore's skills/ subtree SHA is RE-READ by ref at v0.15.0, not carried forward from a64e795e in the description above; quest's skills/ subtree SHA is resolved by ref at v0.15.0 too. (2) The CLAUDE.md:48 change is the managed-block carve-out (quest agents --update-instructions --target claude) and nothing else; no hand-written line moves. (3) Dispatch only once BOTH @opum-ai/lore@0.15.0 and @opum-ai/quest@0.15.0 are on npm latest AND opum-cli-e2e TASK-179 post-move check is clean. Approved work under the 2026-11-02 scope (3). DEC-226 floor-class (pins, baselines): it waits for a dispatch brief from the leader. Also regenerate .agents/plugins/marketplace.json from the Claude marketplace, and run lore agents --check. Supersedes the lore-only HELD wording in the description.
